name: ETL Facebook Ads To Amazon Redshift
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select Facebook Ads as the data source.
2.  Select your added Amazon Redshift data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [data warehouse](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/destinations/index.html#_datachannel_managed_warehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your Facebook Ads account using OAuth using the process described [in this documentation page](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/set-up/authentication.html#_connecting_using_oauth).
4.  Click on + Data Pipeline to start adding data pipelines to your account.
